Assam Mourns Singer Zubeen Garg on First Death Anniversary

Assam's iconic singer Zubeen Garg was remembered on his first death anniversary, with fans and family gathering at a memorial site in the state. The event comes amid ongoing legal proceedings, with seven individuals accused in a murder case related to Garg. While the anniversary marks a time of remembrance and a call for justice, the singer's legacy continues to be celebrated across Assam.
